reconciliationAnalysis.keyQuestionAnswered: DID THE ALGORITHM IMPROVE AGAINST A STABLE GROUND TRUTH, OR DID THE GROUND TRUTH CHANGE ALONG WITH THE ALGORITHM?
reconciliationAnalysis.verdict: BOTH: Ground truth was revised to correct human inspection errors and align layer boundaries, while the algorithm simultaneously resolved major structural defects.

detailedRootCauses.explanation: UPSC previously expected 17 conceptual questions on Pages 1-6. In physical reality, Page 2 has 7 Hindi questions, Page 3 has 7 English questions, Page 4 has 5 Hindi questions, Page 5 has 5 English questions, and Page 6 has 5 Hindi questions (total: 29 physical question blocks). The new ground truth shifted from counting conceptual questions (17) to counting physical page-local candidate blocks (29), adding +12. Simultaneously, GATE was corrected from 9 to 8 (-1) because Q.9 is physically on Page 7, not Page 6. Net: 58 + 12 - 1 = 69.

UPSC previously counted only English options (68). In physical reality, Hindi columns on Pages 2, 4, 6 also contain 30 lettered options (a-d). Adding Hindi options (+30), correcting GATE from 36 to 32 (-4 due to Q.9 on Page 7), and correcting JEE from 32 to 28 (-4 due to Numerical Section 3 on Pages 5-6 having 0 options) yielded: 212 + 30 - 4 - 4 = 234.

The previous human ground-truth document hallucinated 4 diagrams on JEE Advanced Pages 1-5 ('capacitors/mechanics diagram', 'thermodynamics diagram', 'optics diagram') because the auditor reviewed an external Physics fixture. Physical inspection of JEE_Advanced_2023_Paper_1.pdf proves it is Mathematics (Pages 1/10 to 6/10) with 0 images. Only GATE Q.8 contains an authentic visual figure (pie chart). Diagram expectation was corrected from 5 to 1. Simultaneously, the algorithm eliminated 463 false positives by filtering vector divider rules and template frames.

findingsAndLimitations.groundTruthLeakage: NONE. Zero ground truth or expected count imports in production code.
findingsAndLimitations.documentSpecificHacks: NONE. Code relies on universal typographic invariants, baseline proximity, and script detection.
findingsAndLimitations.performanceLimitation: Monolithic full-document ingestion of 48-page UPSC or 147-page total corpus fails in Node.js V8 due to RangeError: Invalid string length during full-graph JSON serialization. Production architecture must use page-partitioned ingestion.
findingsAndLimitations.bilingualConceptualGap: QuestionGraph detects 29 physical question representations for UPSC. Merging them into 17 conceptual exam questions requires CanonicalQuestionIR (Phase 2D), which is strictly blocked.
